Hi Hannah,

I attended your "Cost & Latency for LLMs" webinar yesterday — great session. FinPulse is evaluating inference platforms for a new feature (real-time summarization for customer emails). I filled out the webinar form and wanted to follow up directly to schedule a short demo focused on integration patterns and latency profiles.

We'd prefer 30 minutes. This week works well for us in the mornings (EST):

- Wed 20 May, 9:30–10:00am ET
